task.title: Copy an existing role
task.shortdesc: Copy an existing role when that role already contains many of the permissions you want to use and you need to change, add, or remove some permissions.

ul.li: You are logged in to the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud ConsoleRed Hat Hybrid Cloud Console as a user who has Organization Administrator permission. You cannot log in to the Hybrid Cloud Console with your email address unless your email address is the same as your Red Hat login. For more information, see .
If you are not an Organization Administrator, you must be a member of a group that has the User Access administrator role assigned to it.
You started the Create role wizard.

prereq.p: An existing role can be one of the predefined roles provided by Red Hat or it can be a previously created custom role.
For a list of predefined roles provided by Red Hat, see section Predefined User Access roles.
prereq.note: You cannot modify a predefined role.

step.cmd: In the Create role wizard, click the Copy an existing role button.
Click the button next to the role you want to copy.
The Name and description window shows a copy of the Role name and the existing Role description filled in. Make changes as needed.
Click the Next button. If the role name already exists, you must provide a different name before you can proceed.
Use the Add permissions window to select the application permissions to include in your role. By default, permissions are listed by application.

info.note: Custom roles only support granular permissions. Wildcard permissions, such as approval:*:* are not copied into a custom role.

step.cmd: Optionally use the filter drop-down to to filter by Applications, Resources, or Operations.

info.note: Use the list at the top of the wizard page to view all the permissions added to the role. You can click a permission to delete it.

step.cmd: Click the Next button to review details. You can click the Submit button to submit the role, the Back button to go back and make changes, or the Cancel button to cancel the action.

result.p: The role you created is available to add to a User Access group.
